data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all repository files, including the PKGBUILD, and found no signs of malicious injection. The package is a standard -bin package that downloads pinned release assets from the official upstream GitHub repository. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely due to an API error preventing it from reviewing the PKGBUILD.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 API failure), which caused it to fail reviewing the PKGBUILD and .nvchecker.toml. The deepseek model successfully reviewed these files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .nvchecker.toml due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: When a model fails to review critical files due to transient API errors, the audit tool should rely on a successful review from another model to resolve the disagreement rather than defaulting to inconclusive.
Implement retry logic for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP errors from causing incomplete audits.
